source.note: Same kit and recipe as mini-male-b (FBX member with its colour map, all 32 clips with their Kenney names, height 1.1 m: Kenney minis are chibi, the head is about 40 % of the body, so a real adult scale would make the head huge; noon script, faceted shading). He is the kit's police officer: peaked cap with a badge, uniform shirt with tie, badge and belt, moustache; Kenney's preview shows him empty-handed (no props in the model). Kenney paints him in a blue uniform with dark-grey trousers; noon has no blue, so his outfit is set apart from mini-male-a (red top, brown trousers), mini-male-b (sand top, black trousers) and mini-female-b (white top, red trousers): brown cap and shirt, near-black trousers, cap band and shoes, sand badges and buckle, red (ginger) hair and moustache. The colour map is split into 24 clusters (ingest.maxColors) so the badge swatch stays apart from the skin tones; Kenney paints his eyes, trousers and cap band with the same greys, so they share the trousers role. The FBX rest pose is a T-pose, so views use idle@0. Ground: moving clips use ground clamp; sit, drive and the wheelchair poses are lifted onto the ground plane by his own probed depths (sit and drive 0.136 m, wheelchair 0.157 m; set their lift to 0 to seat him on a chair or wheelchair at the authored height). His arm stubs stay above the soles, so no clip needs sinkAllowed. The sprint and die clips are authored with real air time.
